physics-killer-11.title: Iziphumo Ze-Photoelectric, Ubume Obubini Bokukhanya, kunye Nehlabathi Elincinci Kakhulu

physics-killer-11.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-11.material: Isuntswana P ingena ngokuthe nkqo kwimagnethi ephakathi ehambelana $B$ kwaye yenza intshukumo yesetyhula engatshintshiyo, umgama we-orbit $5\,\mathrm{cm}$, ixesha $2\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Isuntswana Q ingena ngokuthe nkqo kwimagnethi enye, ubunzima bayo $4$ amaxesha obuka-P, ubungakanani bentlawulo $2$ amaxesha eka-P, isantya $3$ amaxesha esika-P. Umxhuzulane awuhoywa. Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa umgama we-orbit nexesha lika-Q ngokulandelelana?
physics-killer-11.thinking.0: Iziphumo Ze-Photoelectric, Ubume Obubini Bokukhanya, kunye Nehlabathi Elincinci Kakhulu
physics-killer-11.s.s1.prompt: Isuntswana P ingena ngokuthe nkqo kwimagnethi ephakathi ehambelana $B$ kwaye yenza intshukumo yesetyhula engatshintshiyo, umgama we-orbit $5\,\mathrm{cm}$, ixesha $2\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Isuntswana Q ingena ngokuthe nkqo kwimagnethi enye, ubunzima bayo $4$ amaxesha obuka-P, ubungakanani bentlawulo $2$ amaxesha eka-P, isantya $3$ amaxesha esika-P. Umxhuzulane awuhoywa. Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa umgama we-orbit nexesha lika-Q ngokulandelelana?
physics-killer-11.s.s1.explain: Kuba $r\propto\dfrac{mv}{q}$, $\dfrac{r_Q}{r_P}=\dfrac{4m\cdot3v}{2q}\cdot\dfrac{q}{mv}=6\Rightarrow r_Q=5\times6=30\,\mathrm{cm}$. $T=\dfrac{2\pi m}{qB}$ ayixhomekekanga kwisantya, ngoko $\dfrac{T_Q}{T_P}=\dfrac{4}{2}=2\Rightarrow T_Q=4\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Ukuba umlinganiselo wentlawulo uyalityalwa, $r=60\,\mathrm{cm}$, $T=8\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (impendulo engalunganga ①), ukuba kucingelwa ukuba ixesha lilingana nesantya, $12\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (impendulo engalunganga ③), ukuba kuhoywa umlinganiselo wobunzima nowentlawulo kwaye kusetyenziswa umlinganiselo wesantya kuphela, $r=15\,\mathrm{cm}$ (impendulo engalunganga ④).
